notes.subject: אמות הספים
notes.rationale: Talɣa: 'tḥerzekt n yiferdisen' (wid izemren ad ttḥerzcen ɣer iferdisen, am linteaux) neɣ 'iɣẓan n yiferdisen' (iɣẓan n yisfuyla, am ASV). KJV yenna 'posts', JPS 'posts of the door'.

notes.subject: yuli-d deg usgen
notes.rationale: ימלא עשן yegber 'yettwali s usgen / yettwassen s usgen' — talɣa n teqbaylit tettawi-d amejnun n usgen d wayen yettkelsen.

notes.subject: הקורא
notes.rationale: D yiwen (singular) maca JPS yegbur kuẓ (them that called) — ufran n talɣa singular yettwadem i yiles n teɛbranit.

translation: Tḥerzekt n yiferdisen tzenz deg wedɣaɣ n win yettmeslayen, axxam yuli-d deg usgen.
